text: For a linear map T: V -> W with V finite-dimensional, the rank-nullity theorem states:
choices: dim(ker T) + dim(im T) = dim V
dim(ker T) + dim(im T) = dim W
explanation: Nullity (dimension of the kernel) plus rank (dimension of the image) equals the dimension of the domain V. Options using dim W confuse the codomain with the domain; the image is a subspace of W but its size is governed by V. Kernel and image dimensions are generally unequal.
